title: How to Introduce yourself in English -- FOR BEGINNERS!

header.titleZh: 如何用英文介紹自己－適合初學者！
header.titleEn: How to Introduce yourself in English -- FOR BEGINNERS!

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to my Slow English podcast. Take your time. Listen carefully and watch my hand gestures.
sentences.tc: 您好，歡迎來到我的慢速英語播客。慢慢來。仔細聽並觀察我的手勢。

sentences.en: To understand new words in English.
sentences.tc: 理解英語新單字。

sentences.en: Today I want to introduce myself to you.
sentences.tc: 今天我想向你們介紹我自己。

sentences.en: I am Tyiana. My full name is Tyiana Ortiz. My.
sentences.tc: 我是蒂亞娜。我的全名是蒂亞娜·奧爾蒂斯。我的。

tags.meaning: 日常生活相關的常用字
tags.note: 看到 name 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: First name is Tyiana and my last name is Ortiz.
sentences.tc: 我的名字是蒂亞娜，我的姓氏是奧提斯。

sentences.en: I am 21 years old. Actually, I will be 22 years old.
sentences.tc: 我今年21歲。事實上，我今年就22歲了。

sentences.en: Next week. My birthday is November 22nd.
sentences.tc: 下週。我的生日是11月22日。

sentences.en: I will be turning 22 on November 22nd.
sentences.tc: 11 月 22 日我就滿 22 歲了。

sentences.en: I will be turning 22 years old. And in the United States, that is called your golden birthday.
sentences.tc: 我馬上就22歲了。在美國，這被稱為你的黃金生日。

sentences.en: If you were born on January 4th and you turn 4 years old,.
sentences.tc: 如果你出生於1月4日並且你滿4歲了。

sentences.en: Then that's your golden birthday. Tell me when is your golden birthday? Did your golden birthday already pass.
sentences.tc: 那就是你的黃金生日。告訴我你的黃金生日是什麼時候？你的黃金生日已經過去了嗎？

sentences.en: Or not yet?
sentences.tc: 還是還沒有？

sentences.en: I am from the United States, Nebraska. I was born in Nebraska, USA.
sentences.tc: 我來自美國內布拉斯加州。我出生在美國內布拉斯加州。

sentences.en: I grew up in Nebraska, USA. My mom is from the United States. My dad is from Mexico.
sentences.tc: 我在美國內布拉斯加州長大。我媽媽來自美國。我爸爸來自墨西哥。

sentences.en: That's why I look kind of mixed like a cappuccino.
sentences.tc: 這就是為什麼我看起來有點像卡布奇諾。

sentences.en: When I was 8 years old, my dad was deported back to Mexico?
sentences.tc: 當我8歲時，我父親被驅逐回墨西哥？

sentences.en: We all moved to Mexico to live. It was a big change. Everything changed. But Mexico has beautiful.
sentences.tc: 我們都搬到墨西哥居住。這是一個很大的改變。一切都變了。但墨西哥也有美麗的地方。

sentences.en: People and I have a beautiful family. And you?
sentences.tc: 我和人們都有一個美好的家庭。你呢？

sentences.en: Are you from? Where did you grow up?
sentences.tc: 你是來自嗎？你在哪裡長大？

sentences.en: I studied elementary school, middle school, and high school in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 我在墨西哥讀了小學、國中和高中。

sentences.en: I did not study at university. Did you study at university?
sentences.tc: 我沒有讀過大學。你讀過大學嗎？

sentences.en: What did you study? After high school, I began to work to make money?
sentences.tc: 你學了什麼？高中畢業後，我開始打工賺錢？

sentences.en: I worked as an English teacher online. That was my job.
sentences.tc: 我在網路上擔任英語老師。那是我的工作。

sentences.en: I work at my job. I worked as an English teacher.
sentences.tc: 我做我的工作。我擔任英語老師。
